title: Europe: population change 2000–2025
source: GHSL GHS-POP R2023A (European Commission JRC) — resident population grids for 2000 and 2025 at 30 arc-seconds.
note: Each point is an inhabited GHSL cell. Green = more people in 2025 than 2000; pink = fewer. Uninhabited cells are left blank (basemap gray). Built at 30 arc-sec for a browser-friendly tileset; the classic 3 arc-sec maps are a larger offline rebuild.
